components.name: Accordion
components.summary: A stacked list of titles that each open to show more content.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A small label that shows the status or category of something at a glance.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: A colored box that tells readers something important about the page or a task.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A small circle that shows who a person is, with their photo, initials or the IU trident.

components.name: Billboard
components.summary: A large image paired with a short title, description and links that spotlights one important section of your site.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.summary: A short trail of links that shows where a page sits in your site and lets people go back up a level.

components.name: Button
components.summary: A clickable box that lets people take an action, like submitting a form, or move to the next step, like "Apply now."

components.name: Calendar tile
components.summary: A small square that shows a date at a glance, with the month, day and year stacked.

components.name: Callout
components.summary: A highlighted box that draws attention to one thing on a page, with a short title, description, picture and up to two links.

components.name: Card-default
components.summary: A clickable box that previews one page, like a resource, service or degree program, and links to it.
